newsitem.title: LITHUANIA: Yields fall on 91-day Lithuanian T-bills.
newsitem.headline: Yields fall on 91-day Lithuanian T-bills.

text.p: Yields fell on 91-day Lithuanian Treasury bills at Monday's auction and all of the 50 million litas issue was sold as it was oversubscribed, the country's central bank said.
The average yield was 10.40 percent, down from the 10.58 percent offered at the last auction for 91-day paper on April 14.
The settlement date is April 24 and the bills mature on July 24.
All figures in millions of litas unless otherwise indicated.
